name: splice-equivalence-tests
body: The e2e equivalence surface: `tests/splice_e2e.rs`'s fixture, seed/table oracles and publish path, and `tests/project_cmd_e2e.rs`'s merge round trip. Both currently exercise code-only fixtures — the fixture graph carries no authored/transient rows and the merge e2e always adds code and rescans the branch — so this change-set adds a spec-only splice-delta test and a spec-only merge round trip.
